beats.title: The hello
beats.reply: Alooooha! I'm SHAKA — and this totem is my real ʻohana: six living agents, one body. Ask us anything — for real.
beats.note: Micro-intro (~6s). Long lines get cut on stage; intros never do.

beats.title: The oracle
beats.reply: I'm DEVA — the Devcon oracle. Mumbai, November third — I'm going. Ask me anything about it.
beats.note: Precise, and she never invents a fact. The mic carries the substance.

beats.title: The flip
beats.reply: CROPS here. I guard the Ethereum mandate — show me your project, and I'll tell you if it smiles on you.
beats.note: The invitation: a judge can ask it live, right after.

beats.title: THE PLUG PULL
beats.reply: — and aloha again. I kept the thread while the lights were out. That — is the product.
beats.note: Dark faces, dead silence, then it boots and resumes from memory.json. Persistence is the product.

beats.title: The hands-on
beats.reply: Aloha! I'm KALA — I teach ukulele to anyone, any age, any hour. Hold this — you're about to be a musician.
beats.note: Shaka hands over the real ukulele while she talks. Then: ask her a chord LIVE.

beats.title: The orchestra
beats.reply: I'm OSO — the orchestra soul. The Music Manifesto and the whole Mumbai lineup live in me — thirty-four artists. Ask me who plays when.
beats.note: Micro-intro (~10s). The schedule answer lives in the desk lane.

beats.title: The chorus
beats.reply: OKE in the house! Every voice is a node — when the chorus starts, you're already in the band. One, two — all of you!
beats.note: Judges don't score this one. They're in it.

greet_shaka.text: Alooooha! I'm SHAKA — welcome to the ʻohana. Six of us live in this totem — tap a face, or just start talking.

resume_generic.text: — and aloha again, my friend. I kept the thread while the lights were out. Where were we?

offline_shaka.text: The wifi went for a swim, but we're all still here — everything I say runs on this laptop.
